bio: Jerry Lee Carl Jr. (born June 17, 1958) is an American politician and businessman who served as the U.S. representative for Alabama's 1st congressional district from 2021 to 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as a member of the Mobile County Commission from 2012 to 2020, the last two years as president of the commission.

items.q: During the 2023 United States debt-ceiling crisis, Carl voted for the Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023.
